title: A local gate that reproduces CI before the merge queue: CI's CPUs, containers included, ffmpeg 6.1, every gate
description: About 55% of merge-queue minutes (686 of 1,241 in 4.5 days) went to attempts that did not merge, because the queue is the first place the media tiers run on CI's CPU count and ffmpeg 6.1. tools/tiers.sh runs only unit and integration, on 16 cores and ffmpeg 9; taskset alone does not reproduce CI, since Docker containers are children of dockerd and keep every CPU (the JS-024 escape record). Build the gate to CI's measured CPU count (printed by CI since #98): one TEST_CPUSET variable read in test/lib.sh re-executes the script under taskset and gives every docker run --cpuset-cpus (integration.sh, s3-lib.sh, roles.sh, e2e/run.sh, differential/run.sh, ffmpeg61.sh); run CI's whole matrix side by side in disjoint CPU slots (16 cores hold eight two-CPU slots, about 20 min wall); run every gate, not only touched ones; run the integration tier through test/ffmpeg61.sh. Records in .results/<tree>/ carry the cpuset and the ffmpeg version, so a 16-core, ffmpeg 9 record cannot satisfy the gate; ~/.cache/jellyscale/land.sh refuses to enqueue without one and picks the CI run by head SHA.
acceptanceCriteria: One variable confines both the test processes and every container they start to a CPU set of CI's measured size, in every test script
tools/tiers.sh runs the five integration shards (integration under ffmpeg 6.1), roles and every e2e shard side by side in disjoint CPU slots, and finishes in about the time of one CI queue run
A record says the cpuset and ffmpeg version it ran with, and the gate and land.sh accept only records made as CI runs
The gate fails on the commits before the JS-024 and JS-072 fixes, on JS-028's stale roles check, and on PR 96's copy-job wait (6dc9f54), and passes on their fixes
The first-attempt merge-queue pass rate is recorded per task in .results/tasks.jsonl; the target is 90% or better
source: Fable 5.2 architecture review, 2026-11-12 (.results/architecture-review-2026-11-12.md); owner's answers 2026-11-12; amended by Fable 5.2 CI review, 2026-11-12 (.results/ci-review-2026-11-12.md); owner approved A, B, C, D and the later items
notes: Dropped 2026-11-13 (owner): rehearsing CI locally before every queue attempt cost more runs than the queue failures it saved. The merge queue is the gate; a failure there is fixed on a new commit. Spec drafts kept outside the repo.
